label: Write
summary: Turn speech into clean text for the field focused when you choose Stop, with a saved recovery path when delivery is blocked.
proof: Local transcription is the default; optional shaping is a separate decision.

opening.title: Speak once. Stop at the field where your words belong.
opening.summary: Use Mumble’s deliberate Dictate command and speak while the Island shows what is happening. Keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop. When Stop is requested, Mumble freezes that field as the destination. It then attempts one delivery.

demonstration.spoken: Move the design review to Thursday and send the notes before lunch.
demonstration.note: Illustrative cursor close-up—not a live transcription. The Mumble workspace above is a genuine product capture.

states.label: Choose cursor
states.title: Keep the intended field ready for Stop.
states.body: Place the cursor in the writing field where you want the finished text. Keep it focused, or return to it, before choosing Stop.

states.label: Speak
states.title: Mumble makes its state visible.
states.body: Use the global Dictate command and speak. Before choosing Stop, keep or return focus to the intended field. The Island shows Listening, then Transcribing.

states.label: Text returned
states.title: Stop freezes the intended destination.
states.body: When Stop is requested, Mumble freezes the focused field for one target-bound insertion. If delivery cannot complete, the result remains recoverable in the Deck.
states.field: Project note — Move the design review to Thursday and send the notes before lunch.

mechanism.title: One deliberate command. One visible route back.
mechanism.summary: Write keeps the Stop-time destination, processing state, privacy route, delivery attempt, and recovery path in one understandable sequence.

steps.title: Keep the intended field focused for Stop
steps.body: Place the cursor in a writable field. Keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop. Mumble then uses the field focused at Stop instead of asking you to move into a separate editor.
steps.proof: The destination is frozen when Stop is requested—not when recording starts.

steps.title: Start with the deliberate global Dictate command
steps.body: Invoke Dictate from the application you are already using. The Island shows Listening, then Transcribing, so recording and processing are visible rather than implied.
steps.proof: The same global command starts and stops the dictation.

steps.title: Transcribe on this computer by default
steps.body: Local transcription is the default. Recorded audio stays on this computer unless the user explicitly selects Cloud transcription.
steps.proof: Optional shaping is a separate finished-text decision.

steps.title: Return once, or recover safely
steps.body: Mumble attempts to insert the finished text at the field frozen when Stop was requested. If insertion cannot complete, the result is saved in the Deck and History for Copy or Paste latest instead of being sent again automatically.
steps.proof: Later focus changes do not authorize a new destination or a second blind insertion.

tasks.title: Everyday notes
tasks.summary: Add a complete thought to the note already open in front of you.
steps: Place the cursor at the point where the note should continue.
Use the global Dictate command and speak the thought in ordinary language.
Keep or return focus to that field before you choose Stop; the Island then shows the transition into transcription.
Continue from the inserted text, or use the saved Deck result if delivery could not complete.

tasks.title: Longer text
tasks.summary: Draft a connected passage without replacing the document you already chose.
steps: Place the cursor in the draft where the next passage belongs.
Start Dictate and speak the passage at a comfortable pace.
Keep or return focus to that field before you choose Stop; the Island then shows the transition into transcription.
Review the returned text in the draft, or recover the finished result from the Deck if insertion was blocked.

tasks.title: Across applications
tasks.summary: Carry the same Write sequence into another writable desktop application.
steps: Open the destination application and place its cursor in the intended field.
Invoke the global Dictate command without leaving that application.
Speak, then keep or return focus to the intended field before you choose Stop.
Mumble attempts one return to the field frozen at Stop; if that field is unavailable at delivery, it keeps the text in the Deck rather than inserting elsewhere.

label: Capture
summary: Record microphone meetings into a local, searchable working record you can review and export.
proof: Mumble saves the recording locally before transcription and later analysis.

label: Shape
summary: Give finished text a deliberate job, including Prompt, Email, Reply, and Deck actions.
proof: Cloud text shaping is optional and sends finished text—not recorded audio—through the chosen route.

label: Listen
summary: Read documents with saved progress, find, bookmarks, summaries, and optional voice playback.
proof: Provider-backed speech is an explicit online choice and may carry the provider's own cost.

label: Find
summary: Use Mumble Find to search local apps and files without hosted results entering the list.
proof: Web Search is separate and sends selected text online only after provider-named confirmation.
